effects: The vault takes exactly `assets` WETH (0x4200…0006 on Base) from the signer with safeTransferFrom; the signer must have approved the vault.
The vault mints steakETH shares to `receiver`. The number of shares comes from the stored exchange rate after fee accrual (floor rounding), and the signer sets no minimum.
The vault supplies the WETH to Morpho Blue markets in its supply queue. This changes the vault's positions, not the signer's.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the WETH amount sent, the share ticker 'steakETH' as a constant, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many steakETH shares the receiver gets; the vault rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The descriptor shows only the constant field 'Share ticker' = $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The share count comes from storage, and the function has no minimum-shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name WETH, the vault or the steakETH shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", interpolatedIntent absent; the code takes WETH and mints steakETH (ERC4626._deposit).
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit WETH into Steakhouse ETH vault". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Deposit {assets} for steakETH to {receiver}".

effects: The vault takes WETH from the signer. The amount is computed from `shares` at the stored rate, rounded up, and it is not in the calldata. The signer's WETH allowance to the vault is the only cap.
The vault mints exactly `shares` steakETH to `receiver`.
The vault supplies the WETH to Morpho Blue markets. This is the vault's position.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: WETH' as a ticker without an amount, the number of steakETH shares minted, and the receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much WETH leaves the signer; the vault rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The WETH amount comes from storage, and the function has no maximum-assets parameter. The only bound is the signer's allowance.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays WETH for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint"; ERC4626._deposit runs `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit WETH to mint steakETH shares". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Mint {shares} to {receiver} for WETH".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakETH shares from `owner`. The number is computed from `assets` at the stored rate, rounded up.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner` (_spendAllowance).
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
The vault withdraws the WETH from Morpho Blue markets in its withdraw queue.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', 'Withdraw exactly' with the WETH amount, the receiver 'To', and the 'Owner' of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many steakETH shares are burned from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` No field shows the shares.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The share count comes from storage, and the function has no maximum-shares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not name WETH or say that steakETH shares are burned.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Withdraw WETH from Steakhouse ETH vault". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` steakETH from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`. The amount is computed from `shares` at the stored rate, rounded down, with no minimum.
The vault withdraws the WETH from Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the number of steakETH shares to redeem, the receiver 'To', and the 'Owner'.

findings.title: redeem does not show which asset or how much WETH the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` ERC4626._withdraw sends `_asset` (WETH) to receiver. No field names WETH or the amount.
findings.fix: The amount comes from storage. Add a constant field 'Receive asset' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker so the signer sees that WETH arrives.

findings.title: redeem intent 'Redeem' does not say that steakETH is burned for WETH.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: "intent": "Redeem", with no field that names the underlying WETH.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Redeem steakETH shares for WETH". Add an interpolatedIntent: "Redeem {shares} for WETH to {receiver}".
